title: Constituency Development Fund Allocation Announced
excerpt: Rs. 5 crore allocated for road development and healthcare infrastructure in rural areas.
content:
We are pleased to announce the allocation of Rs. 5 crore from the Constituency Development Fund for critical infrastructure projects.

Key areas of focus include:
- Rural road connectivity in 15 villages
- Upgradation of 3 primary health centers
- Solar street lighting in market areas
- Construction of community halls

Citizens are invited to submit suggestions through the constituency office or online portal. Public consultation meetings will be held in each block starting next week.

title: Press Release: Response to State Budget 2026
excerpt: Welcoming budget provisions for rural development, education, and women welfare schemes.
content:
The state budget 2026 presents a balanced approach towards development and welfare. We welcome the increased allocation for:

1. Rural infrastructure development
2. Free healthcare for senior citizens
3. Scholarship schemes for girl students
4. MSME support for local entrepreneurs

We urge the government to ensure timely implementation of these schemes at the grassroots level.

title: Public Message on International Yoga Day
excerpt: Join the community yoga session at Gandhi Maidan on June 21st at 6 AM.
content:
Yoga is India's gift to the world — a path to physical wellness and mental peace. On the occasion of International Yoga Day, we invite all citizens to participate in a community yoga session at Gandhi Maidan on June 21st at 6:00 AM.

Free yoga mats will be provided. Let us come together to embrace this ancient tradition for a healthier tomorrow.

title: Town Hall Meeting - May 2026
excerpt: Open forum for citizens to discuss local issues and development priorities.
content:
An open town hall meeting will be held on May 25th, 2026 at the Constituency Office from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

Agenda:
- Review of ongoing development projects
- Grievance redressal
- Q&A session with citizens
- Presentation on upcoming initiatives

All residents are welcome to attend and share their concerns.
